name: t2-hygiene
cmd: set -e; bash research/track-m/prepare-vendors.sh; bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null; bun run check; export LAB_DEMAND_PROPOSALS=1 LAB_SOURCE_MS=5000 LAB_SOURCE_TRACE=1 LAB_CONDITIONAL_PROOF=1 LAB_SECTION7_CAPTURE=v7-input/demand-and-sources.log LAB_SECTION7_MEASUREMENT=T2 LAB_SECTION7_CLEAN_WITNESSES=1; for law in 'Inv*' Inv2973; do for target in 0 1; do LAB_SECTION7_TARGET=$target timeout -s KILL 90 bun research/track-m/active-source-probe.ts replay-input/input.json "$law" 5 all; done; done

name: construction-leaves
cmd: set -e; bash research/track-m/prepare-vendors.sh; bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null; bun run check; bun test research/track-m/phase-census-meter.test.ts research/track-m/section7-followup-meter.test.ts; work=$(mktemp -d /tmp/section7-followup-XXXXXX); trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT; TRACK_M_PHASE_CENSUS=0 LAB_SECTION7_T1=0 timeout -s KILL 150 bun research/track-m/run-phase-census.ts focused replay-input/input.json control > "$work/control.log"; TRACK_M_DISPOSABLE_PROFILE=1 bun research/track-m/install-phase-census.ts "$work/original"; TRACK_M_DISPOSABLE_PROFILE=1 bun research/track-m/install-section7-cost.ts --followup; bun run check; LAB_SECTION7_FOLLOWUP=1 LAB_SECTION7_T1=1 TRACK_M_PHASE_CENSUS=1 timeout -s KILL 150 bun research/track-m/run-phase-census.ts focused replay-input/input.json candidate > "$work/profile.log"; bun research/track-m/pack-section7-receipts.ts "$work/control.log" "$work/profile.log"
